definitions.explanation: A gathering held after an event or project to look back on what happened, discuss what went wrong, and draw lessons for next time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{反省会|はんせいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We held a review meeting after the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反省会|はんせいかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{改善点|かいぜんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: At the event debriefing, we discussed points to improve.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{反省会|はんせいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}かす⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}した→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧。
examples.english: When the project ended, the team held a review meeting and organized the issues to apply next time.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧ (reflection, self-examination) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (meeting). Despite the word's literal sense, a {反省会|はんせいかい} can be lighthearted — among friends it sometimes just means gathering for drinks to rehash an event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反省会|はんせいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a review meeting
- {反省会|はんせいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct a debriefing
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{反省会|はんせいかい}: privately replaying one's own mistakes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧: celebration party (after an event) — festive, to mark completion rather than to reflect
- ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: meeting — the general word, with no reflective purpose implied
